messages:
anya: quick follow-up from the postmortem  short thread to lock owners for token TTL drift, missing audit events, and bulk secret rotates.
cory: i can own token checks + CI smoke. will add a daily job and alert if >0.5% drift.
mina: i'll take audit pipeline fixes and the verification step after rotation. will coordinate with compliance for retention changes.
anya: suggested TTL defaults: user <=30d, service <=7d, ephemeral <=24h. putting into runbook draft.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-4832  audit retention update (https://tracker.redwood/INFRA-4832)
cory: CI snippet i'll add:
```bash
# token-ttl-smoke
python infra/check_token_ttl.py --env prod --user-ttl 30 --service-ttl 7
```
will add a PD policy for >0.5% violations.
mina: audit gaps were in authz-service (rotation events filtered) and edge-proxy (sampling on subset). ENG-6022/ENG-6023 opened.
eng-sre: ENG-6023 assigned to platform-sre for sampling flip.
anya: secrets: ops-catalog flags 10 keys stale. who can run bulk rotate?
mina: i can run the rotate after cory's CI is green and checklist passes. propose Fri 2026-04-17 09:00 PT.
cory: fine. i'll aim to have CI smoke live by 2026-04-03.
anya: action summary to add to tracker: cory - token CI + PD (due 2026-04-03); mina - audit fixes + rotate run (due 2026-04-17); anya - runbook TTL + final signoff (due 2026-03-29).
mina: i'll post the pre-rotate checklist in INFRA-4832 and ping downstream owners.
anya: thanks all. closing this compact thread; i'll mirror tasks into the remediation board. re-open if blockers show up :thumbsup:
